name: Creamy Lemon Pasta
description: This Creamy Lemon Pasta is a quick and easy weeknight dinner that tastes like a special occasion! Each piece of pasta is coated in a bright and zesty lemon sauce that’s silky smooth. Full of cracked black pepper and parmigiano, one bite of this creamy sauce is like taking a trip to sunny Italy!
recipeIngredient: ½ cup freshly fine grated parmesan reggiano cheese
Garnish: cracked black pepper (extra lemon zest, extra cheese)

recipeInstructions.text: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
recipeInstructions.name: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.

recipeInstructions.text: Add black pepper to the dry skillet and heat on medium-high heat. Cook for 1-2 mins or until very fragrant. Add the butter to a skillet and stir around. Once it melts, sprinkle the flour in and cook for 1-2 minutes, whisking frequently.
recipeInstructions.name: Add black pepper to the dry skillet and heat on medium-high heat. Cook for 1-2 mins or until very fragrant. Add the butter to a skillet and stir around. Once it melts, sprinkle the flour in and cook for 1-2 minutes, whisking frequently.

recipeInstructions.text: Add in the broth and let the mixture come to a low simmer. Whisk in cream and cook it for a few minutes until the sauce has thickened slightly.

recipeInstructions.text: Add fresh pasta to the boiling water and cook according to package instructions.
recipeInstructions.name: Add fresh pasta to the boiling water and cook according to package instructions.

recipeInstructions.text: Stir in the parmesan cheese and take the skillet off the heat. Season with salt & pepper to taste.
recipeInstructions.name: Stir in the parmesan cheese and take the skillet off the heat. Season with salt & pepper to taste.

recipeInstructions.text: Add the drained pasta to the skillet along with lemon zest and juice. Toss until pasta is coated. Add in ¼ cup of pasta water at a time if the sauce becomes too thick.

recipeInstructions.text: Garnish with more parmesan, lemon zest, black pepper and a bit of chopped parsley if desired. Serve immediately.

review.reviewBody: This recipe was exactly what I needed for dinner after a busy workday. I ended up adding some spicy Italian sausage and green peas to the dish. The lemon flavour is so pronounced and delightful. I will definitely be adding this to my regular rotation!
